stories.title: Melania Trump brokers truce for besieged Ukraine city of Oleshky
stories.summary: Ukraine and Russia both confirmed a truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, a city the White House said was 'on the brink of disaster' after residents were left eating garden weeds. It is a rare locally agreed pause in fighting brokered through the US first lady.

stories.title: Macron calls deadly shooting near Paris a 'racist terrorist attack'
stories.summary: One person was killed and five wounded in a series of attacks near Paris, and the suspected gunman has been apprehended. Macron's framing makes the case a national security and hate-crime matter days after nationwide protests over policing.

stories.title: Ukraine says Starlink is still restricted despite Trump saying limits were lifted
stories.summary: Ukrainian officials say Starlink service remains curtailed even after Trump said he would 'get it straightened out' if there was a problem, with the network used by Ukraine's military. The gap between Washington's statements and the ground reality leaves a key battlefield link in limbo.

stories.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at a church funeral in Jordan
stories.summary: Gunmen killed seven people and wounded 34 at a funeral in southern Karak governorate, Jordanian officials said, and a manhunt is under way. The attack on a religious gathering is one of the deadliest security incidents in Jordan in years.

stories.title: SpaceX's carrier push reportedly taps 80,000 US cell sites
stories.summary: SpaceX is reportedly in talks to access at least 80,000 US cell sites to underpin Starlink Mobile as a fourth nationwide carrier. The move would put Starlink Mobile directly against AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile.

stories.title: Google says Gmail and Photos data may now be used to target ads
stories.summary: A revised Google privacy policy states that opting in to better AI recommendations also opens that data to more personalised advertising. It is a notable expansion of how consumer data feeds Google's ad business as assistant features grow more personal.

stories.title: Agent cloud startup Daytona hits $1B valuation
stories.summary: Daytona, which gives each AI agent its own cloud computer, raised a round led by FirstMark at a $1 billion valuation with angels including founders of Stripe, Perplexity and Datadog. The deal signals investor appetite for infrastructure built specifically for autonomous agents.

stories.title: Quest Diagnostics confirms patient health data stolen in breach
stories.summary: Quest Diagnostics confirmed that patients' personal and health information was compromised in a breach affecting its Quanum health records platform. It is the latest in a run of hacks at healthcare technology companies holding sensitive medical data.

stories.title: Ward, Williams and Delpit all questionable for Browns vs Titans
stories.summary: Cleveland added cornerback Denzel Ward to the injury report as limited with a hand injury, leaving him questionable along with Quincy Williams and Grant Delpit for Sunday in Tennessee. Losing three defensive starters would test a defense carrying a 4-2 team.

stories.title: Browns must solve Titans' game-wrecking Jeffery Simmons
stories.summary: Todd Monken got to know Jeffery Simmons' older brother at Southern Miss, and now has to scheme around the Titans defensive tackle with Deshaun Watson and a struggling pass game. Keeping Simmons out of the backfield is the central matchup of Sunday's trip to Tennessee.

stories.title: Browns' season win total climbs to 8.5 as respect lags
stories.summary: Cleveland is tied for first in the AFC North, yet the market has moved its preseason win over/under from the 5.5-6.5 range to 8.5. A win at Tennessee would push the Browns to 5-2 and likely force more national acknowledgement.

stories.title: Browns warned Tennessee is 'the ultimate trap opponent'
stories.summary: Cleveland's Friday newswire framed Sunday as a trap game: the Titans are 1-5 and last in the league in offense at 236 yards a game, and Cam Ward is 4-19 as a starter. The Browns have already lost once this season as a heavy favourite, to the Jets.

stories.title: Matt Patricia says Ohio State's defense must 'level up' in bye week
stories.summary: With Ohio State off for the only time in a 13-week stretch, defensive coordinator Matt Patricia is using the week to push improvement rather than rest. The Buckeyes next play at No. 16 USC on Oct. 31 with Luke Fahey at quarterback.

stories.title: Buckeyes weigh one quarterback or two after Julian Sayin's injury
stories.summary: Buckeyes coverage focused Friday on how Ryan Day will handle the position with Sayin out several weeks: ride Luke Fahey alone or use Tavien St. Clair in packages. The decision looms before a road trip to USC following the bye.

stories.title: Where Ohio State stands analytically heading into the bye
stories.summary: A numbers review of Ohio State's season to date lands after Ohio State moved up to No. 2 in the Coaches Poll and No. 3 in the AP Top 25 following its win over Indiana. It frames what the off week needs to fix before the closing stretch against USC and Oregon.

stories.title: Guide to Ohio State's bye week: 10 games to watch and Michigan's QB problem
stories.summary: A weekend viewing guide highlights the matchups that matter to the Buckeyes' resume and dips into Michigan's issues with Bryce Underwood at quarterback. With no game Saturday, other results shape the playoff picture around Ohio State.

stories.title: Ferrari drivers play down much-hyped Austin upgrade
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc tempered expectations for Ferrari's United States Grand Prix upgrade package despite a promising first practice. Leclerc has said a bigger prize than second in the teams' championship is what he is chasing.

stories.title: Leclerc fastest in FP1 for the United States GP
stories.summary: Charles Leclerc topped first practice at Circuit of The Americas with a 1m36.052s, edging Max Verstappen by 0.084s and Lando Norris by 0.245s. Kimi Antonelli, fifth on the day, can clinch his first title this weekend in Austin.

stories.title: Norris warns McLaren his car is 'one of the hardest I've ever had to drive'
stories.summary: Despite poles and wins this season, Lando Norris called his McLaren a nightmare to handle at times ahead of the US GP. The admission complicates McLaren's push to close out the championship in the closing rounds.

stories.title: Renault to sell its former F1 engine facility at Viry
stories.summary: Renault has secured a buyer for the Viry factory after winding down its Formula 1 engine programme. The sale closes a chapter on one of the sport's longest-running engine operations as the 2026 regulations reshaped powertrain strategy.

stories.title: Players report being loaded into raids already in progress
stories.summary: Escape from Tarkov players are reporting that matchmaking is dropping them into raids that are already underway, leaving late arrivals on an already-looted map. The complaints follow the recent patch wave and the Scourge Incursion event in The Lab.

stories.title: Tarkov Arena patch 0.6.1.5 strips high-tier ammo from Wildcard class
stories.summary: Battlestate's 0.6.1.5 update removes top-tier rounds such as M995, M61, BS and AP-20 from weapons available to the Wildcard class during its event. The aim is to lengthen time-to-kill and restore armor's value, with a player survey to follow.

stories.title: Final week of central Ohio high school football regular season
stories.summary: Football Friday Nite's last regular-season edition pairs Gahanna Lincoln and Pickerington North as the game of the week, with playoff berths on the line across central Ohio. Scores and highlights are being updated through Friday night.

stories.title: Amazon answers questions on $2B Sunbury data center before vote
stories.summary: Amazon public policy VP Shannon Kellogg addressed electricity and water use concerns ahead of a November vote on the proposed $2 billion Sunbury data center. The project has become a test case for how central Ohio weighs data-center growth against utility costs.

stories.title: Ohio posts the nation's biggest five-year drop in housing affordability
stories.summary: A National Housing Conference report found Ohio had the largest loss of homeownership affordability in the US between 2020 and 2025. The finding lands as Columbus-area buyers face higher prices and rates heading into next month's elections.

stories.title: Juvenile struck by vehicle in northeast Columbus
stories.summary: A juvenile was hit by a vehicle near Stelzer Road in northeast Columbus, according to a public safety dispatcher, who said the driver remained at the scene. No further details on the child's condition were immediately released.
